shapeSummary: Pololu Tic T825-style controller: 35.5x30x1.6 mm PCB with one 2.5 mm mounting hole, a 12-pin header with plastic base along the left edge (pins up to 14 mm), a 6-position screw terminal block block on the right edge (about 11 mm high), a cylindrical electrolytic capacitor, and a micro-USB shell block on the back edge. Bottom of the PCB is at Y=0.
warnings: Dimensions are estimates; the supplied bounds were remapped so Y is vertical (height 14 mm) and the board plan is 37 x 30 mm in X-Z.
Only the mounting hole at the lower left is modeled; its position and diameter are approximate.
Header pin count (12), terminal block size, capacitor, and USB connector sizes and positions are estimated.
Small SMD components, LEDs, the gold heat-sink pad, silkscreen, and logos are omitted.
Terminal block screw holes and wire openings are omitted because their geometry is uncertain.
Header pins are modeled as square posts flush with the PCB underside, not as separate protruding legs.

def bx(x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1):
    return cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1-x0,y1-y0,z1-z0,centered=False).translate((x0,y0,z0))

# PCB (plan in X-Z, Y up), 1.6 mm thick
pcb = bx(-18.5,17.0,0,1.6,-15,15)
hole = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(-14.5,-11.5).circle(1.25).extrude(5,both=True)
pcb = pcb.cut(hole)

# 12-pin header along the left edge
hx = -16.8
hdr = bx(hx-1.27,hx+1.27,1.6,4.1,-15.24,15.24)
for i in range(12):
    z = (i-5.5)*2.54
    hdr = hdr.union(bx(hx-0.32,hx+0.32,0,14,z-0.32,z+0.32))

# 6-position screw terminal block along the right edge
term = bx(11.0,18.5,1.6,11.0,-10.5,10.5)

# electrolytic capacitor
cap = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(-4,0).circle(3.25).extrude(-6.0).translate((0,1.6,0))

# micro-USB connector on the back edge
usb = bx(-3.75,3.75,1.6,4.2,-15.5,-9.9)

part = pcb.union(hdr).union(term).union(cap).union(usb)
